scope_note: These requirement IDs capture claims documented in profiles/battery/README.md's field-mapping table — not RFC2119 normative clauses from SPECIFICATION.md the way profiles/core-dp/requirements/core-dp-requirements.json does. A pass in this harness means 'this profile's documented field usage validates against the core v0.2.0 schemas and is internally consistent,' not full LOOP conformance (see profiles/core-dp/ for that) and not regulatory compliance or Battery Passport certification (see docs/governance/CLAIMS-AND-MATURITY.md). Article 77's implementing/delegated acts remain unadopted; nothing here depends on their still-pending mechanics.

requirements.contract_location: profiles/battery/README.md#field-mapping (Battery category row; End-of-life material recovery row)
requirements.summary: A MaterialDNA record that sets classification.battery_category is a battery at end of life, and category must be ewaste-batteries.
requirements.rationale: profiles/battery/README.md and docs/category-classification-mapping.md both document that the same physical battery moves from ProductDNA (in use) to MaterialDNA category ewaste-batteries at end of life — battery_category has no other MaterialDNA category to attach to.
requirements.testability_statement: Vector-testable: schema-shape check that classification.battery_category only accepts the five Annex I enum values (portable/lmt/sli/industrial/ev), plus a semantic check that classification.battery_category implies category=ewaste-batteries on MaterialDNA.

requirements.contract_location: profiles/battery/README.md#field-mapping (Passport identifier and resolvable location row; Data carrier reference row)
requirements.summary: passport.passport_id, passport_url, backup_copy_url, and data_carrier_id carry the battery passport's identifier, resolvable location, and physical data-carrier reference.
requirements.rationale: The Regulation requires passport data to survive the economic operator's own discontinuation (hence backup_copy_url); LOOP stores the data carrier's identifier only, not the encoding itself.
requirements.testability_statement: Vector-testable: schema-shape checks on passport_id/passport_url/backup_copy_url/data_carrier_id field types, formats, and length limits.

requirements.summary: passport.supported_regimes includes "battery-passport" to mark a record as Battery Passport-relevant.
requirements.rationale: Gives federation peers a consistent hint that a record carries battery-passport-relevant fields, without implying conformance to Article 77's still-unadopted mechanics.
requirements.testability_statement: Vector-testable: supported_regimes only accepts its five enum values (espr-dpp/battery-passport/ppwr/waste-shipment/nkws).

requirements.summary: traceability.due_diligence_ref points at supply-chain due-diligence documentation, independent of the passport obligation's own timeline.
requirements.rationale: The critical-raw-materials due-diligence obligation was separately postponed to August 18, 2027 (Regulation (EU) 2025/1561) — this field is a reference only, not a due-diligence status or verification result.
requirements.testability_statement: Vector-testable: due_diligence_ref is a bounded-length string field.

requirements.summary: passport.visible_to expresses the intended minimum audience tier (public/operator/regulator), echoing Annex XIII's three-way split without implementing its still-pending access mechanics.
requirements.rationale: See docs/access-scope-model.md — this is LOOP's own generalized vocabulary, not a literal implementation of Annex XIII.
requirements.testability_statement: Vector-testable: visible_to only accepts its three enum values.

requirements.contract_location: profiles/battery/README.md#field-mapping (Hazard and safety information row; Carbon footprint declaration row; Recycled content row)
requirements.summary: passport.hazardous, material_safety_info_url, carbon_footprint_kg_co2e, and recycled_content_percent carry declared (not verified or per-substance) values.
requirements.rationale: profiles/battery/README.md flags recycled_content_percent as a known gap: a single aggregate percentage cannot represent the Regulation's eventual per-substance minimums — this requirement only covers the aggregate field LOOP actually has today.
requirements.testability_statement: Vector-testable: carbon_footprint_kg_co2e and recycled_content_percent numeric ranges (minimum 0; recycled_content_percent maximum 100).
